equivalent: SURVIVES BY DESIGN, EQUIVALENT. Nothing observes the key order of SPORT_RULES. Every consumer indexes it by sport key (SPORT_RULES[sport]); the only iteration, Object.keys(SPORT_RULES) in apps/web/src/lib/__tests__/match-rules-best-of-one.test.ts:35, is .sort()ed on the next lines. No UI, API or output lists sports in this table's order. Evidence: git grep -a SPORT_RULES over apps, packages, tools, scripts (2026-10-13). Field order WITHIN a sport is the observable one and is pinned by the Task 5 per-sport contract tests.
